summary:
Reviewed w99: commit 52141df (between ready->claimed 6941c6e and claimed->done 6c9095c; the branch work/w99 is gone), the same commit the implementer's result lists.
It binds r30/r31 in a new step module and changes no_version to quote the held text in double quotes, which is what the scenarios' text asks for.
No features/ change, no test removed or weakened, no allowances claimed; r30/r31 scenarios and test_migrate_upgrade.py pass.
Observation: when the held text contains a newline, the hook's output now runs to two lines (repr used to escape it), and a double quote is not escaped. The plan left this open; the fix would be json.dumps.
Drop: the new When duplicates the existing session step; ruff style findings on the added lines match the files' existing style.
tools check: vulture clean, no import contracts; size: nothing over 300.
